global_discoveries.technical_takeaway: Multi-agent orchestration harness combining specialist sub-harnesses (Research, Code, etc.) with external agents in a shared memory task graph; supports RSI where AI rewrites prompts/policies/strategy; 0.963 Node F1 on Multi-Agent Orchestration Benchmark; open source Apache-2.0.

Persistent memory with retain/recall/reflect operations using semantic/keyword/graph/time retrieval; builds mental models instead of flat logs; 91%+ on LongMemEval; open source, integrates with Claude Code, LangGraph, etc.; ~4.5k+ stars recently.

10 open-source projects for persistent/long-term agent memory including Mem0 (66k+ stars), Hindsight, Cognee (knowledge graphs), Graphiti, Letta (identity across sessions), and benchmarks like Agent Memory Benchmark; enables experience→remember→connect→retrieve→act→update loops.

New arXiv papers: DolphinBench (Pareto frontier for memory cost vs performance), EnSIMem (entity-structured indexing for long-term recall), Just-in-Time Memory (task-adaptive curation), Graph Memory cost analysis, and Total Cost of Agency attribution.
